source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Ballymoney Free Press nominations report of 15 May 1930

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Thirteen divisions received a single nomination each and were returned unopposed, so there was no poll; the round is filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
